name: Slot Canyon
desc: The inside of a sandstone slot canyon, rendered as a volume rather than a picture — telescoping sinuous wall fins recede into stacked aerial haze toward a glowing crack of sky, a shaft of light spears down through suspended dust, and the camera dollies forward forever so the sedimentary strata slide past in parallax and new fins are born at the vanishing point; incandescent sandstone, austere chiaroscuro, a glacial ice crevasse, sumi ink wash, or drafting blueprint.

energy.doc: how hard the light burns — lip incandescence, shaft intensity and ambient dust glow

scale.doc: canyon width — from a tight crack you can barely see sky through to a wide airy gorge

speed.doc: forward dolly rate — how fast the walls slide past and new fins are born (0.2 still creeps)

density.doc: count of dust motes suspended in the air

haze.doc: atmosphere — aerial-perspective depth stacking + how much the shaft and ambient glow read as volume

twist.doc: sinuosity of the walls: 0 = a straight architectural cleft, 1 = a writhing water-carved slot

hue.doc: primary rock hue (sandstone amber by default)

y.doc: height of the vanishing point / where the shaft enters

style.doc: aesthetic: incandescent sandstone / austere near-monochrome chiaroscuro / glacial ice crevasse / sumi ink wash / drafting blueprint

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the wall sinuosity, strata and motes

alpha.doc: layer opacity — fades the whole canyon out
